subject.title: Rescue: add watchdog core service and cron engine

question: Should OpenClaw core accept an internal rescueWatchdog cron payload and service-control recovery surface now, and under what operator-security constraints?
rationale: The PR adds a core cron/API/runtime recovery capability that can probe, restart managed services, and run doctor fallback, so automation cannot choose the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a rebased core path
options.body: Keep this PR open only if it is rebased onto current main, carries forward protocol/store/command compatibility, adds real-host proof, and receives maintainer security review.

options.title: Defer to the design issue
options.body: Keep the broader recovery work tracked by the canonical issue and close or replace this stale branch if maintainers do not want a core cron watchdog now.

options.title: Accept after contributor fixes
options.body: Allow the contributor to continue this branch if they resolve the blocking findings and provide redacted live watchdog recovery evidence.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebased core path
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if it is rebased onto current main, carries forward protocol/store/command compatibility, adds real-host proof, and receives maintainer security review.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to the current cron protocol/store surfaces that this PR must integrate with after rebase.
